subject: Aquaculture Site - Southwest Coast - Hermitage Bay
text:
Aquaculture Site - Southwest Coast - Hermitage Bay
Four sentinel cages have been deployed in the Hermitage Bay region in the vicinity of:
Furbys Cove
 47 36.507N 055 49.926W
Top of Hermitage / Barasway Harbour
 47 39.659N 055 41.586W
Bottom Gaultois Passage / L'anse a Flamme
 47 37.335N 055 53.484W
Top Gaultois Passage / Deer Cove
 47 40.438N 055 55.674W
These installations are marked with two surface floats and a high-flyer visible at each location.
Caution.
